name: bloomberg-terminal-dense
title: Bloomberg Terminal Dense
description: Ultra-high-density financial workstations with strict tabular alignment, high-contrast tickers, compact controls, and zero decorative whitespace.

typography.fontFamily: Arial Narrow, Roboto Condensed, Arial, sans-serif
typography.monospaceFamily: IBM Plex Mono, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace

rules: Optimize every panel for scan speed, comparison, and deterministic keyboard operation.
Use 24-column workspace grids and eight-pixel spacing; do not waste terminal space on hero layouts.
All numeric values use tabular monospace figures, aligned decimals, and explicit units.
Amber indicates active context; green and red indicate signed movement with arrows and labels.
Separate panels with exact one-pixel rules, not floating cards or ambient shadows.
Keep controls compact without dropping below accessible keyboard and pointer targets.
Dense labels remain legible; never use tiny low-contrast text to manufacture density.
Live updates must not shift surrounding layout or steal focus.
Reserve monospace for data and commands; headings remain concise and structural.
Animation is limited to immediate state feedback and is disabled under reduced motion.
